reviewScope: GoodFirms, Sortlist and Clutch public official rules rechecked October 23; other entries retain their previous review. No account, application, purchase, message or publication was made.
policy: Only pursue editorial or directory links that accurately represent the business. Do not buy links, fabricate offices, reviews, certifications, or client results.

prospects.name: GoodFirms
prospects.eligibility: Official page offers a free listing application with research verification; acceptance and exact evidence requirements remain subject to review. No mandatory case-study/reference count was confirmed.
requiredBeforeSubmission: Explicit owner authorization for this platform and approved public contact details
Owner-confirmed company name, actual location, services and capacity
Review actual application requirements without inventing credentials or client evidence
prospects.internalEvidenceRecommendation: Prepare genuine permitted portfolio material and references when available; the earlier two-case/two-reference target was an internal readiness recommendation, not a verified platform minimum.
prospects.notes: Free application is not guaranteed acceptance, a followed link, traffic or AI citation. Do not buy a paid plan solely for SEO.

prospects.name: Sortlist
prospects.eligibility: Global providers in relevant advertising categories can create free profiles. Official help describes a mainly Benelux/French/Spanish marketing focus and includes an SEO backlink in paid Sortlist+; free-profile backlink attributes are not confirmed.
requiredBeforeSubmission: Explicit owner authorization and approved public contact details
Owner-confirmed English company profile and logo
Use only permitted genuine portfolio work if supplied; no fake client examples
prospects.internalEvidenceRecommendation: One genuine portfolio example is helpful for credibility, not a confirmed mandatory entry count.
prospects.notes: Lower priority for the current US/HK Simplified Chinese objective. A free profile may support discovery, not a promised SEO link. No paid membership, credits or promotion authorized.

prospects.name: Clutch
prospects.cost: free profile; paid verification currently starts at USD 499 per year
prospects.eligibility: Clutch currently allows a website URL and core company information on a free profile, while a directory-page Visit Website link and stronger placement are Verified features. Profiles are manually reviewed and locations must be truthful.
requiredBeforeSubmission: Explicit owner authorization and accurate public company/contact information
Never invent portfolio examples, reviews or locations
prospects.internalEvidenceRecommendation: Genuine case studies and a review pipeline improve credibility; no mandatory two-case rule was verified. Referral tracking and explicit budget approval are prerequisites for considering any paid upgrade.
prospects.notes: A basic profile may support discovery and reviews, but do not assume a followed directory link. Do not pay solely for a backlink. Reassess after genuine portfolio evidence and tracking exist.

prospects.name: Google Partners
prospects.eligibility: Requires performance, managed spend, and certification thresholds in the registered manager account.
prospects.notes: Never display a Google Partner badge until Google confirms current company eligibility.

prospects.name: Google Business Profile for US or Hong Kong
prospects.eligibility: Google requires in-person customer contact; online-only businesses are not eligible.
requiredBeforeSubmission: A real staffed location or eligible in-person service operation
prospects.notes: Do not create virtual, mailbox, or fabricated US/Hong Kong locations.

prospects.name: DesignRush
prospects.eligibility: Current official submission value and terms have not been verified.
requiredBeforeSubmission: Confirm link attributes and lead quality
prospects.notes: No submission until an official process and business value are confirmed.
